name: tokenmancer
description: See what every AI coding prompt really costs — a live AI-Credit meter, session replay, and a what-if simulator, right inside your editor.

tokenmancer.showPrompts.description: Show prompt text and tool commands in the meter, session replay, and analytics. Off by default for privacy — token counts, costs and file targets are shown either way.

tokenmancer.budgets.monthlyCredits.markdownDescription: Credits you intend to spend per month. Alerts fire at 50%, 80% and 100%. Leave empty for no monthly budget.

tokenmancer.pricing.defaultModel.description: Model used to price a call when the debug log does not name one.

tokenmancer.pricing.poolCredits.description: Credits in your non-rolling monthly seat pool.

tokenmancer.privacy.showPaths.markdownDescription: Report which repo-relative files the agent read or edited. Contents are never reported, and absolute paths are always withheld.

tokenmancer.alerts.enabled.description: Fire budget alerts. Turning this off disables the whole alerting path.

tokenmancer.alerts.cooldownMinutes.description: Minimum gap between alerts for the same budget period. A breach of the limit itself always gets through.

tokenmancer.alerts.maxPerHour.description: Hard cap on alerts per hour. Anything beyond it is counted, not shown.

tokenmancer.radar.enabled.description: Warn while an agent loop is still running when it gets unusually expensive.

tokenmancer.radar.loopCredits.description: Credits a single agent loop may spend before Cost Radar speaks up.

tokenmancer.radar.loopSteps.description: Steps a single agent loop may run before Cost Radar speaks up.

enumDescriptions: Plain-language summary with a Learn card; the step tables and dense metrics are one click away.
Every step, every metric, the full breakdown.
tokenmancer.ui.defaultDetail.description: How much detail the meter and analytics open with. The in-view toggle overrides this and is remembered per machine.
